title: Necessary conditions for the Markovian Mpemba effect
summary: The Mpemba effect is a thermodynamic anomaly in which a system farther away in temperature from equilibrium thermalizes before one that is initially closer. The effect has been experimentally observed across a wide range of systems, including water, colloids, and trapped ions. It has recently been the focus of numerous studies aimed at understanding its mechanisms and developing multiple applications.
